mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submission (user_id, problem_id, language, status, time_ms) VALUES (#{userId}, #{problemId}, #{language}, #{status}, #{timeMs})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.problem_id, p.title AS problem_title, s.status, s.time_ms, s.passed_cases, s.total_cases, s.created_at FROM submission s LEFT JOIN problem p ON s.problem_id = p.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE submission SET status = #{status}, time_ms = #{timeMs}, passed_cases = #{passedCases}, total_cases = #{totalCases} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 6
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS submissionId, s.problem_id AS problemId, d.code AS code FROM submission s JOIN submission_detail d ON d.submission_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 6 ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.problem_id, p.title AS problem_title, s.status, s.time_ms, s.passed_cases, s.total_cases, s.created_at, d.code, d.output, d.ai_review FROM submission s LEFT JOIN problem p ON s.problem_id = p.id LEFT JOIN submission_detail d ON d.submission_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
